headline: Weathered Expanse Front Shows Fresh Movement
war_summary: The latest returns show the principal struggle still concentrated in Weathered Expanse and Mooring County, though the tempo is uneven. Weathered Expanse recorded 91 strategic-base events in 24 hours, down from 100 in the preceding edition, and now stands at four Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral positions; only one event fell in the newest two-hour window. Mooring County remains in close contention at seven Warden, four Colonial, and one neutral base, with 55 events in 24 hours and six in the latest two hours. Stlican Shelf has shifted to two Warden, seven Colonial, and no neutral bases, after 12 daily events and one recent movement. Marban Hollow remains unchanged at one Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral base, despite 13 events across the day. Callahan’s Passage retains all ten Warden bases after 13 daily events, while Deadlands shows sharply accelerating casualty rates around its ten Colonial and one neutral positions, but no recorded base events. Several older fronts have gone quiet.
